items.statement: Fewer than 60 percent of inpatients referred from the hospital in 2024 and 2025 were housed within six months, and incomplete referral forms were the main reason for failure.
items.rationale: Directly shapes the pathway; depends on the data-sharing agreement.
items.risks: Provider data may not record why a referral failed.

items.statement: Referred inpatients have fewer emergency department visits in the following year than matched eligible non-referred inpatients.
items.rationale: One matched comparison suggests this; novelty is not judged here because it depends on whether the local comparison differs from the published one.

items.statement: Social workers who know a named housing worker refer more often and more completely.

summary: Three hypotheses across both strands; h1 selected; one novelty score left unjudged.
